description: Erection of a single storey side extension, single storey rear extenson, side roof dormer extension and rear roof dormer extension.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A101  Received:  10 February 2021;  A102; A103; A105  Received:  26 February 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors and other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey side extension, single storey rear extension, side roof dormer extension and rear roof dormer extension hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - The side window of the side roof dormer extension hereby approved shall be obscure glazed, non-openable below 1.75 metres above finished floor level and shall be permanently retained as such.
